notes.title: Lazy Galaxy 2 is Fully Released Today!
notes.content:
[b]Our next game, Lazy Galaxy 2, is launching now![/b] 
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27023349/91d437ddbda34bdf03a86c2fdaee7ee925d5249f.png[/img]
Lazy Galaxy 2 is an idle/clicker game with base-building and RTS elements. It stayed in early access for more than 6 months and on full release, you can experience these new features:
- mod support
- idle combat
- late-game upgrades and improvements
As well as other bug fixes/balancing and quality of life improvements.

Get the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477950/Lazy_Galaxy_2/?utm_source=steam&utm_campaign=release_day
And as we are celebrating the Full Release of Lazy Galaxy 2, we are announcing discounts for all of our games!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27023349/07d79972df8ad4b704dde0c1059e0fa379b01f75.png[/img]

Thanks for playing our games and supporting us! Hope you'll enjoy Lazy Galaxy 2 as much as we do!

If you’d like to learn more about the game or want to hang out with devs and other Coldwild Games community members, you’re welcome to join us at: [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/coldwildgames]discord server.[/url]

Want to help us out? Consider spreading the word via Twitter, Reddit, etc. and leaving a review on Steam if you enjoyed the game!

Have a great rest of the week,
Elizabete and the rest of the Coldwild Games crew

notes.title: Blades of the Righteous v 1.4 is out!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It's time for the new Blades of the Righteous update. The huge focus of this patch was making the battle more appealing and less repetitive. In order to do this, 4 new abilities (2 for support and 2 for action phase) for every non-boss unit have been added. 2 of those are available right after purchasing the unit. Other 2 are unlocked as the unit progresses. This also involved increasing max energy of all units.

Gameplay
[list]
[*] To make gameplay a bit more interactive: increasing active adventure amount to two
[*] Every units turn is split into three phases: move, support, action. The units can use additional abilities during support phase. Action phase is used for attacks / main abilities now.
[*] Increased portal spawn frequency by 2 turns for easy, 3 turns for medium, 4 turns for hard difficulty
[*] More than 30 new unique battle abilities! In total, units have 88 (repeating) abilities added to them. Each unit has at least 6 abilities when fully levelled now.
[*] The current phase is displayed in the right corner of the active unit.
[*] Improved tutorial to explain attacking better.
[*] You can now use 1-6 keys to activate abilities (instead of clicking on them)
[*] Shieldbash cooldown increased by 1 (now 4 instead of 3)
[*] Stunning Arrow cooldown increased by 1 (now 4 instead of 3)
[*] All stun durations reduced to 1 turn (instead of two) - stun proved to be too strong over the course of the game
[/list]

Abilities:
[list]
[*] the abilities synergize with each other, unlocking unit combos that can benefit each other
[*] 'Courage': +1 hp for 4 turns
[*] 'Stable Position': min dmg = max dmg for two turns
[*] 'Mark': mark target for more damage
[*] 'Orkish Endurance': restore 2hp, +1hp for 2 more turns
[*] 'Rabid Bite': deal 1 damage, apply poison, remove all healing effects
[*] 'Scare': apply -1 damage for 2 turns
[*] 'Calcium': +1 to all resistances for 2 turns
[*] 'Clean Slate': 'Remove ALL effects'
[*] 'Poison': 'Poison the Target'
[*] 'Honor among Thieves': restore 3 energy, heal 3 hp if there's another rogue or brigand in team
[*] 'First Aid' - heal ally for 2 hp, remove bleeding
[*] 'Potion' - heal ally for 2 hp, remove remove poison
[*] 'Magic Breaker': -2 magic resist, 2 damage(S)
[*] 'Piercing Breaker': -2 piercing resist, 2 damage(S)
[*] 'Slashing Breaker': -2 slashing resist, 2 damage(S)
[*] 'Blunt Breaker': -2 blunt resist, 2 damage(S)
[*] 'Cripple':, 2 damage, enemy can't block/dodge next attack
[*] 'Recharge': add recharge counter, if unit has 3 counters - restore 15 energy
[*] 'Dominate the Weak': 'Deal min. atk damage + 4 damage if target is weakened'
[*] 'Feed': deal 2 dmg, restore 2 hp
[*] 'Headbutt': deal max damage(Blunt)
[*] 'Immobilize': deal 3 magic damage, target can't move next turn (still can cast spells)
[*] 'Peacemaker': deal 2 damage(magic), make unit lose 2 hp when he attacks (until next turn)
[*] 'Insult to Injury': Deal min. atk damage + 4 damage if target is bleeding
[*] 'Vulnerability': -1 to all resistances
[*] 'Internal Bleeding': bleed for 1 damage for 4 turns
[*] 'Double Assault': attacks twice, each attack deals 60% base damage + all other bonuses
[*] 'Holy Fire': deal 2 damage, apply burning (2 dmg x 2 turns)
[*] 'Defensive Offence': deal 3 damage, gain +1 resistances for 2 turns
[*] 'Explode': deal 3 magic damage, deal 5 more if target is burning
[*] 'Amplify Poison' - deal 5 magic damage, increase poison duration and damage by 1 each
[*] 'Painful Retribution' - deal 4 damage + 1 damage for every 8 own hp missing
[*] 'Bloodbath' - deal 4 damage (Magic) + 2 more damage if target is bleeding
[*] 'Damage Weapon' - reduce enemy damage by 2 for the next turn
[/list]

New abilities distributed by unit:
[list]
[*] 4 new swordsman abilities: 'Magic Breaker', 'Courage', 'Cripple', 'Stable Stance'
[*] 4 new orc abilities: 'Pierce Breaker', 'Mark', 'Dominate the weak', 'Orkish endurance'
[*] 4 new wolf abilities: 'Headbutt', 'Feed', 'Rabid bite', 'Dominate the Weak'

[*] 4 new bat abilities: 'Slashing Breaker', 'Insult to injury', 'Rabid Bite', 'Scare'
[*] 4 new mage abilities: 'Clean Slate', 'Immobilize', 'Peacemaker', 'Poison'
[*] 4 new rogue abilities: 'Blunt Breaker', 'Honor among thieves', 'Damage Weapon', 'Insult to injury'

[*] 4 new witch abilities: 'Slashing Breaker', 'Immobilize', 'Vulnerability', 'Internal bleeding'
[*] 4 new brigand abilities: 'Pierce Breaker', 'Honor among thieves', 'Double assault', 'Potion'
[*] 4 new paladin abilities: 'Blunt Breaker', 'Damage Weapon', 'Recharge', 'Holy fire'

[*] 4 new skeleton spearman abilities: 'Scare', 'Defensive Offence', 'Calcium', 'Push Back'
[*] 4 new skeleton axeman abilities: 'Magic Breaker', 'Double Assault', 'Calcium', 'Scare'
[*] 4 new skeleton archer abilities: 'Scare', 'Explode', 'Calcium', 'Amplify Poison'

[*] 4 new ghost abilities: 'Amplify Poison', 'Slashing Breaker', 'Immobilize', 'Recharge'
[*] 4 new orc archer abilities: 'Explode', 'Orkish endurance', 'Bloodbath', 'Mark'
[*] 4 new orc brute abilities: 'Insult to Injury', 'Orkish endurance', 'Potion', 'Painful Retribution'

[*] 4 new archer abilities: 'First aid', 'Stable Stance', 'Slashing Breaker', 'Amplify Poison'
[*] 4 new viking abilities: 'Magic Breaker', 'Painful Retribution', 'Reenergize', 'Potion'
[*] 4 new spartan abilities: 'Headbutt', 'Defensive Offence', 'First Aid', 'Stable Stance'

[*] 4 new barbarian abilities: 'Pierce Breaker', 'Damage Weapon', 'Painful Retribution', 'Stable Stance'
[*] 4 new angel abilities: 'Clean Slate', 'Peacemaker', 'Reenergize', 'Holy Fire'
[*] 4 new Samurai abilities: 'Blunt Breaker', 'Headbutt', 'Potion', 'Mark'

[*] Witches withering skill remade: always reduces 30% of target health.
[/list]

Bugfixes
[*] Fixed skeleton archer damage type to piercing, no longer causes game crash when trying to check out its stats

Here's the video where I try to give better explanation:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dT_Fckefp-Y

I'm sure there ought to be a bug or two around. Let me know if you find something and I'll make sure to fix it ASAP. As usual, any feedback is appreciated.

I'll continue doing my best to improve the game and I promise if there's something you want to see - you'll see it!

Cheers,
Vladimir

notes.title: 1.3.1 patch and UI fixes
notes.content:
I've been receiving some feedback lately, and based on it I've decided to make some changes in how the game looks and works:

[list]
[*] Reworked unit stats window: shows resistances / damage type as icons now, all stats have tooltips to give an overall idea what's going on.
[*] Spells like 'Flame Push' (target in row until first) will show their range regardless if there are valid targets or not - makes controls more intuitive
[*] Improved battle log - looks better and is more informative (shows how much hp units has restored and damage is shown AFTER all mitigations now)
[*] Typo fix (1 portal instead of 1 portals) on boss screen
[/list]

Walking Curse: as it is now, the ability seems underwhelming. I've buffed it a bit to (hopefully) be a viable option for mage to learn.
So, buffed 'Walking Curse' skill/ability (+2 tiles for every level):
[list]
[*]"2 turns, 6 tiles, 1 dmg each
[*]"2 turns, 8 tiles, 1 dmg each,
[*]"3 turns, 10 tiles, 1 dmg each
[*]"3 turns, 12 tiles, 1 dmg each
[*]"4 turns, 14 tiles, 1 dmg each
[/list]
I've also added small particles when target with walking curse starts to walk

Let me know if you notice some bugs or want something else added!
Cheers,
Vladimir

notes.title: Blades of the Righteous - version 1.3 is out!
notes.content:
Gameplay Changes:
[list]
[*]Units can now move and attack / use abilities at the same turn, this should increase the game speed
[*]Units now retaliate to attacks (except for the backstabbing attacks)
[*]Added obstacles to battlefield (impassable tiles, block skills that target first unit in the row [*]axe throw, shoot arrow, etc)
[*]Added 150ms delay between unit turns for emphasis
[*]New 'Random Event' - you never knew what you get: Before that, all events generated randomly, but you could always figure out what you are betting on. (i.e. 'get lumber') - now you get a completely random event once in a while.
[*]There are 5 new random events added:
    [list]
    [*] 'Cowards Gauntlet', 
    [*] 'Spooky Situation', 
    [*] 'Supply Line', 
    [*] 'Viking's Existential Hunger', 
    [*] 'A questionable deal'
    [/list]
[*]Events diversified: mining and lumberjacking quests now have 12 possible outcomes (3 good, 3 neutral, 3 bad, 3 terrible)

[*]Added damage types (GENERIC, SLASHING, PIERCING, BLUNT, MAGIC (G/S/P/B/M)
[*]Added armor types to mitigate (or increase!) damage from specific damage types (G/S/P/B/M)
[/list]

UI:
[list]
[*]Castle UI improvements: peasants chat / 'recruited' signs are highlighted better
[*]Fixed Sending to Battle Unit Window: no longer deselects unit if you slide the mouse while left button is clicked
[*]'Skip Turn' button in battle is now flashing when unit cannot attack anyone nearby
[*]Added Backstab / Crit / Resisted text notices
[*]Fixed bug with Gray Order items improperly displayed
[*]Some typo fixes (make sure to report the news ones!)
[*]Changed Action List font
[*]Fixed navigation in main menu: arrows can properly navigate on profile creation / selection
[*]Changed Dialog boxes: header is now red and better visible
[*]Added sounds on successful / failed events
[/list]

Graphics:
[b]The game requires OpenGL 3.3+ compatible video card now.[/b] - if it is not available to you, you can choose older version of the game in properties (go to your library -> select blades of the righteous -> right click on it -> choose 'properties' -> betas -> select the older version of the game there.)
[list]
[*]Graphics: Added blur-bloom effect on battlefield
[*]Graphics: Added unit traces during attacks
[*]Graphics: Added 'dust' on unit movement
[*]Graphics: Battlefield Tiles are reworked
[*]Added effects to most abilities
[/list]

Balance:
[list]
[*]Backstab multiplier reduced to 1.2 from 1.5
[*]Swordsman is faster (can move 2 tiles)
[*]Swordsman energy increased to 25 from 10
[*]Swordsman damage reduced by 1. Will now be 2-4.
Developer comments: the swordsman should feel like a low-damage tank who can assist the team. It has been hard for him to fill this role a lot of reasons: low movement speed, you had to kite opponents; low energy - cannot use much abilities. Now the swordsman has more ability-use potential (battlecries / shield stuns)
[*]Arena challenge of fighting 3 bats reduced to 2 bats
[*]Portal's 'spawn enemy' cooldown reduced to 3 from 4.
[*]Units can no longer backstab portals
[*]Demonic giant [*]fixed a bug when decimate spell dealt 20 instead of 10 damage
[*]Removed extra 2 damage from Berserker's 'Savagery' ability
[*]Barbarian's Bloodlust Skill: Self-Damage to self reduced to 4 from 5
[*]Mage: Fireblast is now a single-target spell that deals 5 damage and incinerates enemy for 2 damage(M) over 2 turns
[*]Mining for gems requires 4 people (up from 2)
Developer comments: since units can move and attack now, they can take out portals faster. The battle dynamics needed to change because of that.
[/list]

Thanks for playing! If you want anything changed - I'm very open to all of your feedback. I want to continue improving the game!

I've tested the game a lot, but this patch introduces lots of changes. If you notice any bugs - do not hesitate to let me know. I'll try to fix them ASAP.
Cheers,
Vladimir

notes.title: Blades of the Righteous v1.3: progress report

notes.title: Blades of the Righteous v1.2 is out!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Blades of the Righteous has nearing the age of two months, so once again, I want to thank you for playing! To celebrate this and to address some recent feedback - I'm rolling out an update.

[b] Gray Order introduced [/b]
You have crossed a way of a mystical band of rogues that prefers to work from the shadows and oppress the peasants of your kingdom. There's no way back! Charge into battle, defeat them and get their equipment to help your cause.
[list]
[*] First event requires you to defeat 2 rogues and 2 brigands
[*] Second event requires you to defeat 4 rogues and a brigand
[*] Third event requirse you to defeat 6 rogues, gives access to Gray Order class items - purchasable at the blacksmith
[*] After that, you get random Gray Order encounters with 4-6 enemies that drop Gray Order items and moderate amounts of gold
[/list]
[b]Elemental Challenges introduced[/b]
Two new events that are here to enhance your late-game! 
[list]
[*] Elemental Challenge: Fire - asks your swordsman to withstand attacks of the fire spirit. When successful - grants 'Legion Killer' item
[*] Elemental Challenge: Nature - asks you to gather army with at least 7 units. When successful - grants 'Alliance Guardian' item
[/list]
[b]New items[/b]
The items are given as rewards for completing the map events.
[list]
  [*] Poisoned Blade (rogue class item): poison 1 ( 1 dmg for 2 turns), damage +1, hp -5, defence -5
  [*] Staff of Exclusion (mage class item): burn 4 energy on every attack, damage -1
  [*] Poisoned Sword (swordsman class item): poison 2 ( 2 dmg for 2 turns), damage +1, defence -15
  [*] Gloves of Gray Order(rogue class item): - damage +2, defence: +10, energy -10
  [*] Gray Hat (mage class item): poison 2, hp -5
  [*] Alliance Guardian: swordsman armor, +1 hp regen for every ally, -2 dmg
  [*] Legion Killer: swordsman weapon, +1 dmg for every living enemy on the battlefield, -6hp
[/list]
[b] UI Changes [/b]
[list]
[*] UI: Added simple tooltips for the unit purchases in Barracks
[*] UI: Action list tooltip added (warns about every action taking up one turn)
[*] UI: "Save and Quit" button position fixed
[*] UI: Added tooltip on how much experience each mission / boss fight grants in Player Screen
[*] UI: PageUp / PageDown keys now move user to the top / bottom of the event list
[*] UI: Adjusted map defeat window position
[*] UI: Fixed bug when tooltip remained present in Unit Stats window
[/list]
[b]Tutorial Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Tutorial: added a clear mention that peasants arrive to the castle every turn
[*] Tutorial: explicitly mentions that map actions take a turn
[/list]
[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Gameplay: Significantly increased exp rewards from side missions
[*] Gameplay: 'Killing your own troops' map event will never grant items anymore
[*] Gameplay: Rescue missions will not give any gold anymore - only unit
[*] Gameplay: Max simultaneous map adventure amount increased to 5 
[*] Items: reduced damage drawback from magic hat, magic hat now simply gives 10 energy
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Bugfix: Fixed a bug when Steadfast skill bonus actually reduced dmg done on enemy (instead of preventing dmg done on unit)
[*] Bugfix: Mana burner item bugfixed, now burns enemy mana instead of restoring it
[/list]

One more thing: I've decided to quit my job and to work full-time on game development. If you enoy the game - I would appreciate if you like and follow my facebook page, [url=https://www.facebook.com/ColdwildGames/]Coldwild Games[/url] - I'll be posting new updates / promotions / announcements there. You can also leave the feedback there.

As usual - please do let me know if there are any bugs / issues with the game and I'll be more than glad to address them.

notes.title: Blades of the Righteous v1.1 is out!
notes.content:
Rolling out the 1.1 patch with content update!
 
 Hello! To celebrate the first two weeks of the release of Blades of the Righteous and to thank you for all the support so far - I am rolling out the patch with a large content update.
 
 The new stuff:
[list]
[*] Addition of heroes - the hero is a special unit that gets stat points after successful battles. Those stat points can be spent to upgrade base stats of the hero (hp / energy / damage / defence). If hero gets killed - you can revive him by paying gold.
 Heroes are permanently unlocked on player's profile by completing map events. Choosing a hero gives special benefits - grim reaper gets 2hp/energy from every death on battlefield, as well as revives one fallen unit as a skeleton. Merchant allows special 'cart' event that gives you resources, his attacks on battlefield grant you gold. The hero, like the normal unit, persist through one map walkthrough. Heroes are accessible on the map screen - 'heroes' icon (or by simply pressing 'H' key).
[*] New resource: Food. Food is required in order for the troops to restore when skipping turn. If you do not have enough food - no units are restored. Food can be gained through new technology (farming), from events or purchased at the market.
[*]Ghost trader event added (unlocked for profile after successful necromancer's offer)
[*]Necromancer's offer #2 event added (sacrifice archer or orc archer for skeleton archer)
[*]Sacrifice archer event added (unlocks on successful ghost trader event)
[*]Merchant's cart event added (when you unlock the merchant and choose him as a hero)
[*] satyr's struggle (when you unlock the merchant) - trade 5 food for random prizes
[*] feed the poor map event added (requires player to give 10 food) - necessary for unlocking Merchant hero
[*]'kill your own' map event added (player needs to kill 2 swordsmen/rogues/mages in any combo) - needed for unlocking Grim Reaper's ressurection power
[/list]
 
 The fixes and balance changes:
- Gameplay: max simultaneous adventures on map increased to 4
- Gameplay: skeleton archer removed from necromancer's offer quest
- Gameplay: 'help the village' event can now reward food
- Gameplay: increased reward from 'help the village' event on higher difficulties
- BUG: fixed the bug when block was not working
- GUI: icon size on map changed to 70x70 from 64x64
- GUI: max 7 icons on map event list instead of 8
- GUI: removed ugly red borders as map event selection
- GUI: unit name is now written in stats window
- BUG: fixed the bug when boss spawned even if no portals have been killed
- BUG: fixed bug when portal battle could end with enemy units alive on the field after portal was killed

IMPORTANT:
I am very sorry, but the old save files for map progress won't be compatible and need to be replaced by new ones. THE LONG-TERM PLAYER PROGRESS STAYS. This step is necessary for the game to evolve and get better. More below:
Save system revamp: in some cases the save files could become corrupt. I have reworked the save file algorithm. Unfortunately, with all new additions it means that old MAP save files won't be compatible with the new version. However, all player progress is still going to be loading/saving properly so your major achievements will be kept.
If you encounter any errors - please report them in the game forums.

Thank you! If you would like something changed or some cool feature added - just write on the forums and we can discuss it.

notes.title: Anouncing update 1.1 to Blades of the Righteous
notes.content:
Hello,

Thanks for your support so far!

I'm planning to do a major update to the game, so here's a brief overview what to expect:

[list]
    [*]Hero Units: 2 of the initial heroes, unlocked through completing various events and battles. The hero can be chosen and summoned for a map. If the hero unit gets killed - it can be ressurected for money (with all the previous stats and skills but no items). After every battle - the hero unit levels a little and you can increase what stats you want to improve (health/energy/damage/defence)!
    [*]New resource: food. The food is needed when forces are resting. If player does not have enough food - no health/energy is restored to the troops, even though the turn skips.
    [*]At least 7 new map events, some of which are unlocked by completing previous events
    [*] Save system revamp: in some cases the save files could become corrupt. I have reworked the save file algorithm. Unfortunately, with all new additions it means that old MAP save files won't be compatible with the new version. However, all player progress is still going to be loading/saving properly so your major achievements will be kept. 
[/list]

Expect it next week, I am planning to release it until 25th of March.
Cheers!

notes.title: 'Surrender' battle function added
notes.content:
Losing games is more fun now!
If you see that your forces are getting overwhelmed - pay your way out.

This is done according to user feedback - up till now it has been very hard to recover from losing all your forces.

The total fix list for this patch is following:
- surrender battle function added: it is possible to pay money (depending on difficulty) to abandon battle and keep the current units
- small fix in battle ui: tooltips are now properly shown above buttons (not below them)
- fixed a small glitch that caused the game crash when window 'close' button is pressed and confirmation dialog is open


Cheers,
Vladimir

- Forfeit button added in options screen in map. Deletes current map (but not game) progress, allowing you to start the map anew if you don't like where the game is going.

Cheers,
Vladimir
